# CAP

> Intent-first capability discovery and consolidation for AI agents.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): human quick start and product overview
- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md): domain glossary (Acquisition, Direct Exposure, CAP-managed, ManagedBinding, Invoked, Pin, Exclude, Trial, Local Inventory, Activity, Observation Period)
- [Product requirements](docs/product-requirements.md): Phase 1 P0 / launch gates with Target / Now / Gap
- [Agent onboarding copy](docs/agent-onboarding.md): first-report URL, partial scan, 10% savings, scoped Restore, USE-09, inspect label map, post-optimize validation, setup reuse (ONB-09), inventory filters / Skill overlap
- [Restore from `.cap-backup`](docs/restore-from-backup.md): JSON MCP and Codex dotted-table TOML optimize recovery (not one-click Restore)
- [OS/Agent compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): inspect paths and optimize-apply formats with tested / expected / unknown
- [ADRs](docs/adr/): material-savings 10%; Observation Period readiness (14 UTC days + 3 activity days)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): module boundaries and data flow
- [Local skills](docs/local-skills.md): discover SKILL.md, overlay catalog, search/add/use without dumping bodies
- [MCP gateway](docs/mcp-gateway.md): `cap.use` stdio binding model (Capability `mcp_tool` + local `mcpServers`)
- [Try mode](docs/try-mode.md): local `cap try` / `cap cleanup` (USE-11); remote catalog try waits for Phase 3
- [Context Health](docs/context-health.md): pressure, funnel, V3 Value Analysis runtime (value/cost), V4 Dynamic Injection plan, inspect/Health contract
- [Catalog schema](data/catalog.schema.json): seed catalog contract
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Entry points

- CLI: `bin/cap.js` → `src/cli.js` (`setup` / `inspect` / `search` / `inject` / `add` / `use` / `try` / `cleanup` / `pin` / `unpin` / `exclude` / `include` / `optimize` / `activity` / `web`)
- Inspect: `src/inspector.js` inventory `scope` / `reasons` / `overlaps`; listing filters via `cap inspect --agent --scope --type --status --source --cost-min --cost-max --reason` and `GET /api/inspect?...` (summary/pressure stay full)
- Setup: `src/setup.js` reuses/upgrades existing `cap-mcp` and removes extra CAP surfaces in the same Agent config (ONB-09)
- Optimize apply: `src/optimize.js` re-inspects after `--apply --yes` and returns `validation` (projected vs actual estimates; fail closed on invalid config / broken CAP surface)
- Pin / exclude: `src/pin.js` (Direct Exposure pin; recommendation exclusion). Default MCP tools stay search/add/use.
- Try / cleanup: `src/try.js` (temporary ManagedBinding; anonymous local outcome). Remote catalog download waits for Phase 3. Default MCP tools stay search/add/use.
- MCP gateway: `src/mcp-bind.js` (launch resolve) + `src/mcp-client.js` (stdio JSON-RPC); `cap.use` calls one mapped tool and implicitly `add`s if the capability is not yet managed. Search/add attach on-demand `input_schema` (`src/input-schema.js`: live `tools/list` when bound, else catalog). Agent `tools/list` stays `cap.search` / `cap.add` / `cap.use`.
- Value Analysis: `src/profiler.js` (V3 value/cost from `use` activity only; Observation Period readiness + frequency/value advice; search/select do not create value scores)
- Dynamic Injection: `src/inject.js` (V4 task → load/defer plan; CLI `cap inject`; MCP `cap.inject` via `CAP_MCP_INJECT=1`)
- MCP: `bin/cap-mcp.js` → `src/mcp-server.js` (tools from `src/mcp-tools.js`: `cap.search`, `cap.add`, `cap.use`; optional `cap.inspect` / `cap.inject`)
- Web: `cap web` → `src/web-server.js` on `127.0.0.1:4173`
- Library: `src/index.js` (`searchCapabilities`, `addCapability`, `useCapability`, `inspectLocal`, `loadCatalog`, `loadState`)

## Agent skills

- CAP: `.agents/skills/cap-develop/SKILL.md`, `.agents/skills/add-capability/SKILL.md`
- Full `mattpocock/skills` pack (37 skills, lockfile `skills-lock.json`) under `.agents/skills/`, including `setup-matt-pocock-skills`. See `skills-lock.json` for the complete name list.
- After clone/merge, run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` once in Cursor/Agent and select GitHub Issues. That step is not done in-tree yet.
- `cap setup` writes user-level `cap-context-health` (not shipped under `.agents/skills`)

## Verify

```bash
npm run check
```
